author: Bloodhusk
quote:
Video games are supposed to be an escape while you play them. They are supposed to take you to different worlds, go to the extremes of reality, allowing people to enjoy themselves with the freedom that we truly do not have in real life. 
Having said that, the latest GTA 6 game is not fun. The game is full of bugs. The people are not appeasing - either through beauty, or absurdity of personality. Nothing really stands out. A direct quote, from my wife: "this is like if a woman wrote a To Do list and handed it to you, expecting it all to be done for some good boy points". The relationship in the game feels like this. The ending was terrible.  
GTA6 is an absolute disappointment, and development has the air of Concord and even Starfield to it. 
Avoid and spend your money elsewhere.

author: Bloodhusk
quote: The story is a complete mess. It makes no sense, and the characters are nothing like the first game, they make awful choices that contradict the first story. Not even worth renting.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: Bloodhusk
quote: Awful. The new models create a mess when grouping units together, making it difficult to separate them. No LAN, no modder support - everything you make belongs to them. The game is massively buggy. I'm positive they plan to roll this out as a mobile game due to the changes. Blizzard is a shell of what it once was.

author: Bloodhusk
quote: Game literally sold based off of Kojima's name and how "Konami did him wrong". This game is boring. If this is is medium to show what he can do with writing/directing movies, he's failed horribly. The biggest part of this salt-lick is I paid $60 for this mess. Its a tech demo with CG scenes plastered all over it. Kojima = Lucas - w/o anyone telling him "no" to bad ideas we get Star Wars prequel series, Death Stranding.
